general_information.Description: The thesis intends to integrate contents already covered in previous courses, as well as to provide an in-depth exploration of a topic of special interest or career relevance to the participant. This thesis project will be completed by a group of 4-6 students, however each student will defend the thesis individually in front of a thesis committee. Students must work closely with an academic supervisor and are required to submit a comprehensive written report as well as make an oral presentation of the research results in front of a professional academic panel. The thesis' topic is concerned with such areas as (1) the impact of Regulation on the Financial-Services Industry; (2) Financial Statements and Financial - Firm Performance; (3) Tools for Managing and Hedging against Risk; (4) Managing Investment portfolios and Liquidity position for Financial Firms; (5) Managing source of Funds for a Financial Firm; (6) Providing Loans to Businesses and Consumers
general_information.StudentTasks: (1) Choose the thesis topic within the selected banking concentration (2) Divide and schedule work (3) Attend all scheduled meetings with the appointed supervisor (4) Produce reports or outcomes according to thesis requirements (5) Defense individually work in front of an examination board (6) All of above must be worked in the appointed group

assessments.Duration: According to deadlines by the Academics Department
assessments.No Question: One piece of written work of no more than 100 pages
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, and research and written skills
assessments.Grading Guide: Evaluation is based on the format, presentation of data, insightful analysis & practical recommendations for the research problems

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: • Report 1: Introduction and Thesis Outline • Report 2: Literature Review and Theoretical models • Report 3: Methodology, Data Analysis & Findings • Report 4: Conclusions and Recommendations
assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on the schedule in the syllabus, each group report will be evaluated by the group supervisor. This evaluation is called progress assessment. • Individual mark for each progress assessment report is decided by the group supervisor and is assessed on the basis of the actual contribution by that individual to the group report. The individual mark can be lower or higher than the group mark and is in the range from 0% to 120% of the group mark where the average score of group members cannot be more than group mark.
assessments.Note: All four personal progress assessment reports account for 24% of the whole Thesis with weights - Report 1: 6% - Report 2: 6% - Report 3: 6% - Report 4: 6%

assessments.Duration: 45 minutes presentation and 45 minutes Q&A for each group
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, and research and presentation skills
assessments.Grading Guide: • Presentation mark is given by each member of referee committee for each student on final project presentation. This personal mark is the average of all member of referee committee. • Total presentation time for each group is 30 mins. Each student must make his or her own presentation.
